title: Nvidia Stock News (Oct 19, 2026): NVDA Falls 1.4% to $214.13
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) fell 1.43% to $214.13 on October 16, 2026, as a broad tech sell-off pushed the Nasdaq Composite down 2.15%.
body_markdown:
The session also had a high-rate backdrop. The US 10-year Treasury yield ended at 5.10%, up 0.9 basis points, a level that matters for how investors price long-duration growth stocks, as explained in our guide to[the yield curve](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/the-yield-curve-explained/) .


## Why Nvidia Stock Fell


None of the sources fetched for this article names a company-specific cause for Friday's decline. The move tracked a sector-wide sell-off: Nvidia fell less than the Nasdaq and less than most of the large chipmakers listed above.


Weekend coverage shows what was weighing on AI infrastructure stocks. According to[The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bond-market-sending-warning-nvidia-223000334.html) on October 18, yields on CoreWeave's 2032 bonds touched 15%, which the outlet reads as a sign the market sees rising default risk at the AI cloud provider. The same piece notes that Nvidia invested $2 billion each in CoreWeave and Nebius this year, so their share prices hit Nvidia's balance sheet directly. It adds that Nvidia agreed last year to buy unused CoreWeave capacity through 2032.


As reported by the same outlet, Amazon, Google and Microsoft are expanding their custom chips (Trainium, TPUs and Maia), a competitive point that has been hanging over GPU demand.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Per[The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/5-trillion-club-better-stock-202000459.html) , Nvidia has forecast 70% revenue growth for the next fiscal year, driven by AI infrastructure demand, and its CUDA software remains a key advantage in model training.
- According to[Simply Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-2-other-fast-growing-220935780.html) , Nvidia generates about $275.4 billion from Compute and Networking and $27.6 billion from Graphics, with data center AI infrastructure as its largest revenue source.
- The Motley Fool reports that Nvidia's bottom line grew 126% year over year.


### Risks


- Debt stress at neocloud partners such as CoreWeave could weigh on Nvidia's finances through its equity stakes and capacity agreement, per The Motley Fool.
- Hyperscalers building their own chips could reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs.
- Simply Wall St. cites an analyst view that uptake of a cheaper or open platform than CUDA would undermine Nvidia's moat, and The Motley Fool notes Nvidia would be among the most exposed stocks if the AI build-out slows.
